name: query_graph
description: Read-only Cypher for multi-hop, aggregation, complexity, or cross-service analysis. Default: 200 visible rows with exact/lower-bound totals and truncation; continue safely with next_cursor. graph=missed is a file tree of flagged coverage gaps; absence is not proof of completeness. Use get_graph_schema(diagnostics=full) for properties.

cursor.description: Snapshot continuation; keep query/project/graph. Format, budget, and max_rows may change.

format.description: tree may use local @N+suffix prefix refs; json uses direct strings.

graph.description: code graph (default) or missed coverage-gap file tree.

max_output_tokens.description: Sizing hint; hard ceiling is 4 UTF-8 bytes/token. Rows stay whole.

max_rows.description: Visible rows (default 200; max 99998); 0 uses the legacy maximum. Evaluation is unchanged.

offset.description: Live compatibility paging; cannot be combined with cursor.
